mods.name: Crops & Plants
mods.description: A mod adding more flora to the game making it feel more alive!

releases.notes:
First release (main); 
Added:
Heracleum - A plant that can be found in Plains biome, can be used to create potions of Heracleum Juice
Heracleum Juice - An effect that damages the affected entity when exposed to sun (Taking cover with blocks helps)
Sprinkler - Can be filled with Heracleum Juice to spew it onto your enemies! When used, gives the affected entity the Heracleum Juice Effect; Can also be filled with Experience to slow down enemies and just scale up the amount of experience points it gives
Lotus - Seeds can be found among Grass, grows only in shallow 1 block deep water, when fully grown and broken drops Lotus Leaves
Lotus Leaves - Can be eaten, but are not a very good food source
Lotus Chips - Obtained by smelting Lotus Leaves in a furnace, give Speed II when consumed
Fungi On a Lotus Leaf - Are a really good food source that gives Saturation II when consumed
